news.title: Aidan Moon Announces That World Buffs Dropping on Loading Screen is Bug
news.description: Aidan Moon has responded on X (Twitter) that World Buffs dropping during a loading screen is a bug.
news.details:
In response to our article that World Buffs are dropping on a loading screen, Aidan "Zirene" Moon replied on X that this is not intended.
He mentions that this is a bug that will be fixed tomorrow and that another bug fix caused it. After this is fixed, players will once again be able to enjoy the World Buffs in dungeons and on the opposing continent!

news.title: Players Can No Longer Peek Inside Lockboxes in WoW: Forever to Fix New Exploit
news.description: With recent hotfixes, players can no longer peek inside lockboxes in WoW: Forever, likely due to a Lockbox exploit.
news.details:
A lockbox exploit has recently been discovered and has started to circulate within the community. Players could previously turn off auto-loot and check the contents of an unlooted lockbox. As Mithril Lockbox contains some very important and expensive items, such as recipes, some rogues found it fun to see what was inside before sending it back to the intended owner. However, players discovered that Lockbox contents could be rerolled.
It's unknown what exactly causes the reroll, but in a post on Reddit, u/intertiae discovered that a Rogue who peeks inside the lockbox will see something different than the recipient of the lockbox after it's been sent in the mail. It's unclear how long this has been going on, or the impact of this on rare recipes, but this is very clearly unintended behavior.

news.title: World Buffs Removed on Any Loading Screen in WoW: Forever
news.description: World Buffs are now removed whenever a loading screen triggers, preventing players from using them in dungeons or on the opposite continent.
news.details:
Aidan "Zirene" Moon has announced that this is a bug. Find out more by clicking here.
World Buffs are a huge buff to characters, and while they don't work in raids in WoW: Forever, they work in outdoor content and in dungeons. Some of the most common buffs right now are Warchief's Blessing or Might of Stormwind from turning in the Head of Rend Blackhand and Mol'dar's Moxie, Fengus' Ferocity and Slip'kik's Savvy from Dire Maul Tribute runs. In a recent undocumented change, these buffs are being completely removed whenever a loading screen triggers. This includes the loading screen when logging in.
The video above shows the Warchief's Blessing buff being removed when Hearthing to Thunder Bluff from Orgrimmar, as it triggers a loading screen. This means that none of these buffs can be used inside a dungeon anymore, as there's always a dungeon loading screen.

news.title: The Weekly Reset with Taliesin and Evitel: Gold in Forever
news.description: Taliesin and Evitel check out the latest news for both Forever and Retail, as well as the gold farm, chores, and exploit controversy in Forever.
news.details:
Taliesin and Evitel cover the latest news and do a deep dive into pertinent topics in The Weekly Reset. This week, the latest news for both Forever and Retail, as well as the gold farm exploit controversy in Forever.
World of Warcraft Forever is getting ready for the launch of its first tier of raids in a couple of weeks, and faced it's first huge test of integrity this week when players discovered the Blackmaw Hold gold farm exploit, and a few (including some huge streamers) became incredibly rich. How would Aggrand and the Forever team react? Some in the community want PERMABANS for offenders, and there's even a petition. Will Blizz make the right call?
We also talk about the very retail-feeling gold weekly quest, as well as Retail NEWS with the announcement of the patch 12.1.7 release date and remind ourselves of what Echoes of the Worldcore has in store.

news.title: The Best Way to Level Lockpicking to Max in WoW: Forever
news.description: In Classic WoW, Rogues had a go-to method for leveling Lockpicking from 250-300. In Forever, that method has changed - no more BRD runs!
news.details:
Lockpicking is a skill that gives Rogues utility, such as opening lockboxes at players’ requests or unlocking chests or doors in dungeons. In Classic World of Warcraft, Rogues had a go-to method for leveling Lockpicking, but WoW: Forever has nerfed it, pushing players to seek alternate leveling methods.
Before, Rogues would head into Blackrock Depths, unlocking three doors that required the Shadowforge Key, and unlocking the Shadowforge lock. This would bring players from Lockpicking Level 250 to 300. However, in testing, the Shadowforge lock itself becomes “grey” around Lockpicking level 265.
The Shadowforge Lock will no longer level you to 300.
Now, the best way to level Lockpicking is to go to Tyr’s Hand in Eastern Plaguelands, which is filled with elite mobs. You'll find Scarlet Footlockers scattered throughout the area. Leveling Lockpicking as a Rogue adds an extra layer of…

news.title: Maximum Dungeons Per Hour Reduced in WoW: Forever Hotfix - Solo Gold Farming Nerf?
news.description: Blizzard has reduced the maximum number of dungeons players can run per hour in WoW: Forever.
news.details:
In yesterday's hotfixes, Blizzard announced they have reduced the maximum number of dungeons to five per hour. WoW: Forever launched with a 10 dungeon lockout per hour, and this nerf makes it match the original Classic Era lockout. It's unclear if the increase to 10 dungeons per hour was intentional or a side effect of using the Modern client.
Either way, this change shouldn't affect anyone doing a full dungeon clear for leveling or gear. Dungeons in WoW: Forever typically take at least 30 minutes to fully clear and players doing this will never hit the cap. For players farming specific things, this change may affect them depending on the run length. With 5 dungeons an hour, if a run takes less than 12 minutes, then you will run into issues with the new cap.
Blizzard may be trying to curb the amount of gold entering the economy from raw gold farms. Soloing any dungeon, regardless of…

news.title: All Quests for New Alcaz Prison Dungeon in WoW: Forever
news.description: Located in Dustwallow Marsh, Alcaz Prison is a new dungeon for players around level 50 in WoW: Forever. Here are all the dungeon quests you should pick up!
news.details:
Alcaz Prison
Alcaz Prison is on Alcaz Island, a lone island in the northeast part of Dustwallow Marsh. This dungeon is on the shorter side and will probably only take about 30 minutes.
The quests for Alcaz Prison are all pretty easy to get. You get three quests for each faction outside the dungeon, plus one in-dungeon secret quest. This secret quest offers a 25 gold reward and only appears when a boss is skipped. After pikcing up the quest, you can kill him for his quest objective.

news.title: Itemization of Crafted Tier Sets Revealed in WoW: Forever's First Raid Tier
news.description: The stats for the crafted versions of Tier Set gear from the first raid tier have been revealed in a hotfix to Forever!
news.details:
More Information:
Blizzard has confirmed with Wowhead that these items stats have been revealed intentionally and can be seen in game directly, as item obfuscation doesn't apply to items from vendors and recipes. They have also confirmed that the set bonuses are placeholder and will be updated in the future.
WoW: Forever's first raiding tier releases on December 9th with a global launch. While Blizzard has intentionally not revealed much about the bosses or the loot they drop, they have now revealed item stats for the crafted tier pieces. We know from a Crix interview that tier pieces will drop across all three raids, but what if you don't have a 40-man, or just get unlucky? Crafted Tier Set pieces could be the solution.
